Michael Jackson’s bodyguard reveals the King of Pop refused to see his own sister Janet at 11:30pm… then stared at her movie billboard months later and asked “is that my sister?” like he had no idea she existed in Hollywood or knew who she was.

“When you was around, Michael, did you see any interaction between him and Janet?”

“The only time that I recall Janet, the whole family pretty much, had came to the house one night, 11, 11:30 at night…  
I had to wake him up, and he didn’t like that.  
And I let him know, I said, Mr. Jackson, your family’s here to see you. They said they’re not leaving until they see you.”

“And he asked me, was Randy there? And I told him no.  
He said, okay, well, I’ll just see my brothers…  
So I went back out… I said, Mr. Jackson said he’ll only see his brothers.  
And Janet said, what about me? I said, I’m sorry, ma’am. He said, just his brothers.  
And she gave me a little attitude…”

“I found it surprising when it come to Janet that we were in New York… there was a billboard of the movie Why Did I Get Married?…  
He looked at the billboard, and he said, is that my sister?  
And we said, yes. He said, oh, is she’s in a play?  
And we’re like, no, sir, it’s a movie. He said, oh, and he asked, how long has it been out?  
I just said it just came out… but I knew the movie was out for a while…”

“No. No. No, I never heard from Latoya.”

“What about Jermaine?”  
“Jermaine, they spoke a few times… He called a few times and they spoke, certainly.”

“Oh, I’ve seen him get emotional a few times, especially when he… we used to call it the red wine moments.  
Because there were times that he would request a bottle or two of red wine…  
About 45 minutes, he’s going to be calling… and he would call and he would vent.  
He would just vent… why can’t people just leave him alone?  
I just want to love and live with my kids and have a normal life.  
I want them to have a normal life…  
And all I could do was just sit back and just listen.  
I felt bad. I did. I felt bad. It was hard not to.”
